lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu)
lines.zh: （嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟）

lines.ja: In a corner of the milky way, the planets turn, going round and round
lines.zh: 银河系的一角，行星转动着，一圈又一圈

lines.ja: A radio wave recording, only an echo returned
lines.zh: 无线电波记录，只有回声返回

lines.ja: how many times does this make it...
lines.zh: 这要多少次才能做到...

lines.ja: In the distant cosmos, I fell in love with you
lines.zh: 在遥远的宇宙里，我爱上了你

lines.ja: Even though I understand that I won’t reach...
lines.zh: 虽然我明白我达不到...

lines.ja: "A-I wanna meet you”- My feelings loop, they loop.
lines.zh: “我-我想见你”-我的感情循环，循环。

lines.ja: I feel like I’m gonna lose it, I can’t exchange with you anymore than that
lines.zh: 我感觉我快要失去了，我再也无法和你交换了

lines.ja: “A-I wanna meet you right now” - the coming days loop too, they loop
lines.zh: “我-我现在想见你” - 未来的日子也会循环，它们循环

lines.ja: Even if you’re not on this orbit….
lines.zh: 即使你不在这个轨道上......

lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) 	There, generally, is only love
lines.zh: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) 一般来说，只有爱

lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) 	There, generally, is only love
lines.zh: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) 一般来说，只有爱

lines.ja: How many light years has it been now, following your voice, disappearing away into the extension cord
lines.zh: 已经过了多少光年了，随着你的声音，消失在延长线里

lines.ja: If I could just forget about it, just like that, I’m sure it would be a lot easier...
lines.zh: 如果我能就这样忘记它，我相信事情会容易得多……

lines.ja: Even though I can’t touch you, I end up seeing you, it just can’t be helped
lines.zh: 虽然触不到你，但看到你却无可奈何

lines.ja: It’s you, so close, yet so far. I understand that
lines.zh: 是你，那么近，却又那么远。我明白

lines.ja: “A-nevertheless I wanna meet you” - I loop around many many times, I loop.
lines.zh: “尽管如此，我还是想见见你”——我循环了很多很多次，我循环了。

lines.ja: My heart is crying with you, that alone is certain
lines.zh: 我的心与你一起哭泣，只有这一点是确定的

lines.ja: That alone… is all I need
lines.zh: 仅此而已……就是我所需要的

lines.ja: Aa, just as the stars turn, we keep on looping forever
lines.zh: 啊，就像星星转动一样，我们永远循环下去

lines.ja: My feelings are drawing an orbit, only chasing after you
lines.zh: 我的感情划着轨道 只追逐你

lines.ja: “A-I wanna meet you right now” - my life loops around, it loops.
lines.zh: “我、我现在就想见你”——我的生活循环往复，循环往复。

lines.ja: Even if you’re not on this orbit….
lines.zh: 即使你不在这个轨道上......

lines.ja: I can’t think of anything else.
lines.zh: 我想不出其他什么了。

lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) There, generally, is only love…
lines.zh: （tuttururuttu ruttutturu）一般来说，只有爱......

lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) There, generally, is only love…
lines.zh: （tuttururuttu ruttutturu）一般来说，只有爱......

lines.ja: (tuttururuttu ruttutturu) There, generally, is only love…
lines.zh: （tuttururuttu ruttutturu）一般来说，只有爱......

lines.zh: （tuttururuttu ruttutturu）一般来说，只有爱......

lines.zh: （嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟）

lines.ja: There, generally, is only love…
lines.zh: 一般来说，那里只有爱……
